{"code": "df_clean = df.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm'])

# Compute mean flipper length by species
mean_flipper_by_species = df_clean.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean()

# Extract and print the exact mean values as produced by code
ad_weight = mean_flipper_by_species['Adelie']
chin_weight = mean_flipper_by_species['Chinstrap']
gentoo_weight = mean_flipper_by_species['Gentoo']

# Print the missing values per species
missing_per_species = df.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].apply(lambda x: x.isnull().sum())

# Print all required values with full precision
print(ad_weight)
print(chin_weight)
print(gentoo_weight)
print(missing_per_species['Adelie'])
print(missing_per_species['Chinstrap'])
print(missing_per_species['Gentoo'])

# Find the species with the highest mean
highest_mean_species = mean_flipper_by_species.idxmax()
print(highest_mean_species)"}
